title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE CHIEF OF THE BUREAU OF PUBLIC LANDS AND ADMINISTRATOR OF THE SAN LAZARO ESTATE TO EXECUTE LEASES FOR OERTAIN LANDS OF SAID ESTATE WITH ROMAN MARTINEZ Y ANDUEZA, VICENTE CENJOR Y CANO, AND MARIANO VELASCO CHUA CHENGCO.

text.en:
The Chief of the Bureau of Public Lands and administrator of the San Lazaro estate is hereby
authorized to execute leases to the persons herein named for the lands hereinafter described, which lands as
herein designated by lot and block are so described on the general plat and form a part of the property
commonly known as the Mayhaligue or San Lazaro estate:
(a) A lease with Roman Martinez y Andueza, tor the period of seven years, to date from the first
day of January, nineteen hundred and two, for lot twelve of block four;
(b) A lease with Vicente Cenjor y Cano, for the period of eight years, to date from the first day
of January, nineteen hundred and one, for lot one of block four;
(c) A lease with Mariano Velasco Chua Chengco, for the period of seven years, to date from the
first day of January, nineteen hundred and two, for lot fifty-eight of block twelve.
